tei:div.tei:p: rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs ni/ gangs ri rwa bas bskor ba'i zhing khams su// phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// spyan ras gzigs dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yi// zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar du brtan gyur cig ༈ /dpal rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng bcu bdun pa'i zhabs brtan ni/ mi phyed rtag pa rang byung chos kyi sku// sgyu 'phrul gzugs kyi skur bzhengs karma pa'i// gsang gsum rdo rje'i khams su rab brtan cing*// mtha' yas phrin las lhun grub dpal 'bar shog /ces pa'ang skyabs gcig rgyal tshab sku phreng bcu gnyis pa mi 'gyur go cha'i smon pa'o/ ༈ /si tu padma don yod nyin byed dbang po'i zhabs brtan ni/ padma 'byung gnas thugs rje stobs chen po/ /mchog gi sprul sku padma don yod 'grub// rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor 'tsho gzhes gsol// mdzad phrin mtha' dag lhun gyis 'grub par shog /
